integrity: All formulas are presented as mathematically derived and self-review only. There is no claim of independent verification, external certification, or publication priority beyond comparisons of accessible sources.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the simple cubic Möbius ladders M_{2n}, n>=3, and labeled vertex sets. It does not classify automorphism orbits, general cubic graph families, or unrestricted (1,2)-domination. Direct exhaustive vertex-subset verification is finite (n<=10); all-order validity uses an explicit finite transfer identity and formal power-series proof. Related minimum-size and divisible-by-four multiplicity results are prior work. Unindexed equivalent all-size enumeration remains possible.
title: A rational enumeration of 1-limited dominating sets in Möbius ladders
